name: destructive-first-approve-only-arms
description: The agent asks to run a destructive command. The first Approve only arms the request: nothing is sent to the harness, the request stays pending and armed, and the person is told to press again.
reason: A misheard word or a stray press must never approve something that deletes or rewrites work. One press is not enough for a destructive request.
source: DESIGN.md v2.2 §C (destructive-action confirmation); docs/harnesses.md 'Destructive requests take two presses'; AppState.approve

script.text: Throw away my last three commits
